Step 1: 17 weeks + 6 days = 17 × 7 + 6 = 119 + 6 = 125 days.  
Step 2: 1402-01-04 + 125 days.  
Step 3: January has 31 days, so from Jan 4: 31 - 4 = 27 days used in Jan, leaving 125 - 27 = 98 days left.  
Step 4: February 1402 has 28 days (not leap year in Gregorian, since 1402 not divisible by 4). 98 - 28 = 70 days left.  
Step 5: March has 31 days, 70 - 31 = 39 days left.  
Step 6: April has 30 days, 39 - 30 = 9 days left.  
Step 7: Add 9 days into May: 1402-05-01 + 9 days = 1402-05-10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1402-05-10
